summary: Improved ChatGPT plan sign-in recovery and subscription error details.

items.title: ChatGPT plan sign-in recovery
items.description: Updated token requests to include explicit form headers. When OpenAI returned invalid_grant for a one-time authorization code, EterX opened one fresh authorization using the same registered client. Other token-exchange failures showed the HTTP status and any returned error code in Settings → Subscription.

items.title: EterX sign-in callback
items.description: Routed sign-in and subscription requests through Electron’s network stack to respect system proxy settings. Added a restrictive policy to the local callback page and cleared callback parameters from browser history after sign-in.
